title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20316v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Heterogeneous AI systems composed of multiple models, architectures, harnesses, or inference-time settings can improve quality and efficiency by routing queries to the specialist who can answer most effectively at the lowest cost. Routing requires estimating each specialist's expected return, but this value estimation has a cost. Cheap estimators (e.g., embedding-based predictors) are fast but noisy, while accurate estimators (e.g., fine-tuned models with access to retrieval results or partial reasoning traces) are expensive. We formalize this tradeoff as an instance of Pandora's Box, the classical problem of optimal search with costly inspection. Under a Gaussian signal model, the resulting policies have closed-form value-of-information expressions that determine, for each specialist and input, whether refining the value estimate is worth its cost. translated_title: 潘多拉的AI模型路由盒：昂贵价值估计下的高效分配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20316v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：由多个模型、架构、框架或推理时设置组成的异构AI系统，可以通过将查询路由给能以最低成本最有效回答的专家，来提高质量和效率。路由需要估计每个专家的预期回报，但这种价值估计是有成本的。廉价估计器（例如，基于嵌入的预测器）速度快但噪声大，而准确估计器（例如，可访问检索结果或部分推理轨迹的微调模型）则昂贵。我们将这种权衡形式化为潘多拉盒子问题的一个实例，即经典的有成本检查的最优搜索问题。在高斯信号模型下，所得策略具有闭式信息价值表达式，该表达式确定对于每个专家和输入，细化价值估计是否值得其成本。我们将这种集中式策略称为潘多拉路由器。我们还将此扩展到去中心化设置。
tldr: 本文通过将AI模型路由中的价值估计成本权衡形式化为潘多拉盒子问题，提出了一种集中式路由策略，能在高成本下高效分配查询。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the cost-value tradeoff in AI model routing as Pandora's Box, proposing a centralized routing policy that efficiently allocates queries under costly value estimation.
